title: comparison-witness
description: The structured mathematical result of a predicatory comparison - not a Boolean answer but a record of the standard used, the inputs, where they agree, how they diverge, and any directed residual. Generated by carrying out a predicatory comparison.

context.description: the comparison context and the cells selected for comparison

standard.description: the comparison standard applied; different standards require different witnesses

agreement.description: the agreement locus - cells or subobjects where the inputs coincide under the standard

divergence.description: the divergence profile: a bilattice-valued difference or defect where the inputs do not coincide

residual.description: directed missing-evidence profile, present only when the inputs are comparable in the knowledge order ≤_k
